action.new:
Exception raised when a nonblank, non-comment continuation line is
   indented more deeply than the preceding valueless option. This
   applies when the *allow_no_value* constructor argument is ``True``.
   Subclass of :exc:`ParsingError`. The original offending line,
   including its line ending when present, is retained.
action.old:
Exception raised when a continuation line (a line beginning with
   whitespace) follows an option that has no value.  This condition is
   only possible when :attr:`!allow_no_value` is ``True``.  Subclass of
   :exc:`ParsingError`.
